# Stage 1 dependencies (generated by tools/uml_from_java.py)

(read with the JDK's `jdeps`, so types reached through a lambda or a chained getter are included),
that is not already an association, generalisation or realisation (CE/CZ2002 Chapter 6, slide 34).
`<<create>>` = instantiates the supplier, `<<call>>` = calls a static method of the supplier,
`<<use>>` = uses it as a type or calls an object of it (e.g. one returned by a getter).
